integration: Call synchronously once with the statically imported DH2E_PICKER_FORMATS and the parsed canonical English JSON before sheet picker writes. Returns true on installation and false on repeated installation. Only qualities.write is replaced.
implementation: Known quality keys are replaced in a new picks array with exact English labels from the original en.json. The original writer then keeps those labels verbatim because source lookup matches keys exactly; its value formatting remains unchanged. Unknown entries are passed through, preserving original behavior. The source catalog, original reader, other formats, original picks, game documents and system files are unchanged.

cases: canonical map exactly matches all 40 original English quality labels
original untranslated-writer bug reproduced with Russian UI labels
all 40 keys round-trip through real format reader with blank, 2 and 0 values
real numeric parser round-trip for all 40 keys
X, PR, PR/2, 2, 0, numeric 0, undefined and null match original formatting
Russian picker labels and chips preserved while English storage is canonical
powerSubtypes and other sources delegate to original
en/de/ru-RU and wrong system delegate to original
this, extra arguments and original picks identity preserved on delegated paths

limit: This patch does not broaden parsers or migrate already corrupted saved data. The original numeric parseWeaponQualities ignores symbolic parameters such as X/PR/2; these are preserved exactly and round-trip through the original picker reader, matching original system behavior.
